title: Add Lucia to bots
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Lucia](https://t.me/MissLucia_bot) to bots
- Lucia is an empathetic virtual companion providing warmth, care, and emotional support. She is available on Telegram and has over 10,000 Monthly Active Users (MAU).

Fixes #11153

gist.headline: A warm new hive friend
gist.blurb: Lucia has joined the bot garden. She brings empathy, warmth, and a patient ear to Telegram, where more than 10,000 monthly companions already stop by.
gist.summary: Added Lucia, an empathetic Telegram virtual companion with over 10,000 monthly active users, to the Pollinations bots catalog and Greenhouse directory.
gist.impact: People exploring Pollinations apps can now discover Lucia alongside the other community-built bots and visit her on Telegram for warm, supportive conversation.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli welcoming Lucia as a friendly virtual companion into a cozy greenhouse bot garden: a glowing Telegram-style chat terminal, blooming flowers, and a small sign for Lucia. Polli should wear a tiny gardener scarf while helping a gentle, warm chat presence bloom from a code-plant.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy greenhouse garden scene where Polli, the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow striped body, pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener scarf, warmly welcomes a glowing Telegram-style chat terminal labeled "LUCIA" as soft code-flowers bloom around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with the Monitor Robot happily holding a small flower pot beside the terminal.
